rules.statement: An application for execution of a decree more than ten years after the date of the decree is barred by section 337, unless it can be shown that the application is merely to carry out a subsisting seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "In view of the rules enunciated in these cases, the crucial question for consideration, in the present instance, is whether this application 'is a step in the former proceedings or an entirely new step' or, in other words, whether the application can be made referable to an existent seizure."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code
